>>G<< OIL SEAL INSTALLATION
1. Apply transmission oil (Hypoid gear oil SAE 75W-90 or 
75W-85W conforming to API classification GL-4) to the oil 
seal lip.
2. Using special tools MB990938, MB990926 <F5M42> and 
MB990928 <F5M51>, press fit the oil seal into the clutch 
housing.
